column1: # Upstream em_msg.cpp readers mapped to Rust tests (note 0009 D6, A10). Upstream: em_msg.cpp at pin ba4180b.
# One row per upstream reader, plus one row per intentional-difference tag in crates/em-msg/src/readers.rs
# (scope tag; a tag on two tests has two rows). Same columns as crates/em-dm/tests/data/upstream_test_map.tsv.
# disposition: rust:<module path of the Rust test> or skip:<reason>; skip reasons: not ported: no production caller.
# tag: parity, or intentional-difference:<id> where the port changes the behaviour on purpose (the id is in a comment of the Rust test).

# triage_verdict is PORT or SKIP; triage_method is not used here (-). Reader rows name the corpus test, which compares each Rust reader with the generated upstream vectors; unit tests are in the notes.
